Who am I?

From a high school tutoring center, to training engineers and rocket scientists, to building deep curriculum on enterprise applications, to researcing how AI can assist in training development or delivery, I've spent a lifetime dedicated to education in all its forms.

After receiving my Ph.D. in Mathematics, I spent 4 years as a mathematics instructor, teaching hundreds of students on courses ranging from basic remedial mathematics to differential equations and linear algebra. I transitioned to technical training on the VxWorks real-time operating system for 4 years, including taking ownership of the most technical courses (board support packages, device drivers, and the network stack) and being the go-to delivery lead and troubleshooter for customers who were having implementation issues post-training. Moving on to enterprise systems, I developed and delivered training for Siebel CRM software for 7 years before moving on to own the configuration and customization content for Oracle Fusion Cloud CRM implementation for 11 years. For the last 5 years I've been a major contributor to Oracle's HCM course suite, including ownership of the benefit and talent management courses. When Oracle decided on an AI-first approach to course development, I explored using AI to develop storyboards for training videos, illustrations for PowerPoint presentations, and workflow diagrams to convert long implementation documents into simple charts.
